messages:
maria: noticed /chat/generate flipped to soft-degrade after a 20s 502 burst. ops got paged and it felt noisy.

ben: hmm. do we have a min-duration requirement? shouldn't degrade until 30s?

ash: current rule is 15s. propose change: require either duration>=30s OR rolling_avg(30s)>threshold. add a spike_suppress that ignores single-window spikes under 40% severity.

tara: UX ask: console should display the exact trigger metric and a tiny sparkline. show policy id + short reason line (eg "policy=soft_v2;reason=502_spike+kv_miss").

maria: also add "snooze alerts" in the inbox for route-level events. one click to silence for 10/30/60 mins and write an annotation to the audit.

ops-bot: deploy queued: soft-degrade-window-increase -> canary 3% at 21:10 UTC :rocket:

ben: action items: ash -> PR for rule change; tara -> mock banner and snooze UI; maria -> one-line runbook for on-call.
